report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; traces show successful downstream calls and healthy connection pools, and metrics show zero 502s. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration). Healthy telemetry contradicts a fault hypothesis, so hand off for human review rather than assert a bounded cause.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency/SLO thresholds for /v1/checkout to determine whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Error-rate or saturation metrics for downstream order, inventory, payment, redis, postgres over a longer window
Evidence of any failing dependency operation (timeouts, errors, pool exhaustion) to substantiate a specific cause
